build_XGPN_model: build an XGPN encoder-decoder model with configurable num_levels and xGPN graph convolution support
run_XGPN_forward: run the XGPN forward pass with input features and num_frms to get encoder and decoder feature lists
create_encoder_levels: create multi-level encoder layers using xGN graph convolutions or standard Conv1d blocks
create_decoder_levels: create multi-level decoder layers with ConvTranspose1d and skip connections from encoder features
review_XGPN_forward: review the XGPN forward method that returns encoder and decoder feature pyramids for temporal action localization
